title: Shared UI sounds
owner: web/ui.js (BettingSound, WinSound, the big-win celebration). Every game plays these; a game never overrides them.

events.label: Click (base)
events.trigger: Base sound. Every panel press falls back to it.
events.prompt: A single soft tactile interface button click, warm muted pop with a tiny crisp tick, very short and dry, no music or voices.

events.label: Confirmation chime (base)
events.trigger: Base sound. Cash out ready falls back to it.
events.prompt: A brief soft two-note interface confirmation chime, warm rounded plucked tones rising gently, dry, no voices or background music.

events.label: Win popup · paper pop
events.trigger: The win popup opens with confetti.
events.prompt: One natural handheld paper party popper. A satisfying rounded cork-like pop immediately followed by a soft short puff of air and delicate falling paper rustle. Warm, playful and dry, close microphone. Total duration 0.6 seconds. No firework crackling, no explosion boom, no metallic sounds, no coins, no bells, no music or voices.

events.label: Win transfer
events.trigger: Coins fly into the balance, played 12% faster.
events.prompt: A small handful of coins dropping into a metal cash tray, bright satisfying brief jingling clinks settling, close mic, under one second, no voices or music.

events.label: Play pressed
events.trigger: PLAY or GO is pressed.
events.prompt: Confident interface button press, warm muted pop with a short bright tick, close-mic, very short and dry

events.label: Cash out pressed
events.trigger: CASH OUT is pressed.
events.prompt: Rewarding interface confirm tap, bright metallic click with a tiny coin ring, close-mic, very short and dry

events.label: Stake down
events.trigger: The minus step lowers the stake.
events.prompt: Small low-pitched interface tick, soft muted pop, close-mic, very short and dry

events.label: Stake up
events.trigger: The plus step raises the stake.
events.prompt: High bright plastic button click, sharp loud transient, close-mic, very short

events.label: Stake to minimum
events.trigger: MIN sets the smallest stake.
events.prompt: Muted low double tick, two quick soft interface clicks, close-mic, dry

events.label: Stake to maximum
events.trigger: MAX sets the largest stake.
events.prompt: Bright crisp double tick, two quick interface clicks rising, close-mic, dry

events.label: Preset stake
events.trigger: A preset amount is chosen.
events.prompt: Poker chip tapped once on a table, sharp bright transient, loud and close, very short

events.label: Auto toggled
events.trigger: The Auto switch is flipped.
events.prompt: Small toggle switch flick, tiny mechanical click, close-mic, dry

events.label: Difficulty opened
events.trigger: The difficulty control or one of its options is pressed.
events.prompt: Soft woody tap opening a small panel, muted interface click with a short tail, close-mic, dry

events.label: Cash out ready
events.trigger: Cashing out becomes possible in this round.
events.prompt: Brief two-note interface chime, warm rounded plucked tones rising gently, dry, no music

events.label: Difficulty selected
events.trigger: Easy, Normal, Hard or Expert is pressed in the tabbed betting panel.

events.label: Header button pressed
events.trigger: Back, avatar/account or menu is pressed in the header.

events.label: Big win · BIG WIN
events.trigger: The big-win window opens on BIG WIN.
events.prompt: A short bright Haitian kompa win sting: a quick sparkling kompa guitar lick and a punchy brass stab over a cowbell and shaker, landing on a happy major chord. Clean, joyful, about one and a half seconds. Guitar, brass and percussion only: no bamboo trumpets, no flutes, no animals, no voices.

events.label: Big win · MEGA WIN
events.trigger: The big-win window climbs to MEGA WIN.
events.prompt: A three second festive Haitian kompa celebration: a bright kompa guitar riff and punchy brass stabs over tanbou drums and a gwiro scraper, a tap-tap bus horn honking along in rhythm, ending on a cheerful brass hit. Joyful street party. Instruments only: no animals, no animal sounds, no voices, no singing.

events.label: Big win · EPIC WIN
events.trigger: The big-win window climbs to EPIC WIN: the kompa band's final hit with coin showers layered after it.
events.prompt: A four second Haitian kompa jackpot finale: a full kompa band with bright guitars, a big brass section and timbales plays a rising triumphant phrase, a fast timbale roll builds up and the whole band hits a huge final chord with a crash cymbal, followed by a shower of gold coins. Joyful and grand. Guitar, brass, drums and coins only: no bamboo trumpets, no flutes, no whistles, no animals, no voices.

events.label: Big win · count
events.trigger: The amount counting up in the big-win window, about ten times a second.
events.prompt: One tiny soft bright coin tick, a single short metallic click like a gold coin counter, crisp and gentle, extremely short, dry, no reverb, no music
